title: presence cache accepts old timestamps that overwrite newer data
description: In PresenceCacheResource.record(), past timestamps are accepted without checking if a newer entry exists. While future timestamps are correctly capped (line 262), the comparison at lines 274-276 only checks for identical entries, not timestamp ordering. An attacker replaying old presence announcements could overwrite fresh presence with stale data or age entries for early eviction. Fix: before updating, check if existing entry has a newer timestamp and skip if so.
